# Side A 0.5.15
- Live countdowns: reset times and "Limit in" estimates tick while the menu is open, and an estimate built on old readings is no longer shown. - Clearer states: a login Side A is still verifying says so instead of "Couldn't connect". - Switching, explained: a claude session that is already running keeps its account. When Autopilot switches, the notification says to quit and run claude --continue to move it. - Sign in again from the menu: right-click any account.
macOS 14 or later. Apple Silicon and Intel. Free.
